BiblicalUsage: tsirʻâh stands behind the English phrase a hornet, a wasp. In Exodus 23:28, I will send hornets before thee, and it appears again in Deuteronomy 7:20.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that God put tsirʻâh exactly where it is, and I trust His placing of it.
